summary: Willamette National Forest L-4 cab built 1930 in Lane County; moved about a mile southeast in 1952-53 and gone after 1968.

facts.status_note: The cab was abandoned in 1968 and disposed of by burning. No source describes what remains at either site.

access.note: The Forest Service lists the Mule Mountain Trailhead as closed due to the Cedar Creek Fire.

notes_for_editor: The original 1930 L-4 cab, the 1933 panorama and the 1968 end agree across sources. The 1952/1953 move and tower height conflict: Weebly #1 says the site was discontinued and duties moved in 1952; Weebly #2 says a 41-ft timber tower with an L-4 model cab was erected in 1952; the register and firelookout say the cab was relocated in 1953, and USGS data may indicate a 52-ft tower. Not resolved. The record point (43.8222, -122.2148) lies about 1.3 km northwest of the register point for the relocated site (43.811020, -122.208390), which fits an original site that was moved about a mile southeast, so no coordinate correction is proposed. The register page found is for the relocated site (US 979, Mule (Spring Prairie)), not for the original site. The Forest Service trailhead closure is cited as the current access status, but the cached page has no date, so recheck before publishing. Photo: FFLOS credits a 1961 Mule Mountain Lookout photo (courtesy of Mark Swift collection); licence unknown, not added.
